# Regent Seven Seas Cruises® Unveils New Bar and Beverage Experiences Aboard Seven Seas Prestige™


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_1b2e3c7bcac26d7344e6cda9183c0af3/nclhltd/news/2026-10-06_Regent_Seven_Seas_Cruises_Unveils_New_Bar_and_830.pdf) October 06, 2026 10:00am EDT


***All-New* *Galileo’s Bar, Mediterranean-Inspired* *Beverages* *and* *an* *Exclusive Seven Seas Prestige Cocktail* *Bring New Flavors to the Regent Experience***


******


***Galileo’s Bar | Seven Seas Prestige***


**MIAMI, October 6, 2026:**[Regent Seven Seas Cruises](https://www.rssc.com/) ®, the world’s leading ultra-luxury cruise line, has unveiled a collection of new and enhanced bars, lounges and beverage concepts debuting aboard *Seven Seas Prestige* ™ in December 2026. From Italian aperitivo and Mediterranean-inspired cocktails to thoughtfully curated zero-proof creations, each experience has been designed to give its setting a distinct identity and bring a sense of discovery to every occasion.


“ *Seven Seas Prestige* represents an exciting evolution for Regent, and that same innovative vision extends to every aspect of the guest experience, including our bars, lounges, and beverage offerings,” said Wesley D'Silva, President, Regent Seven Seas Cruises. “Each venue has been thoughtfully crafted to create its own sense of atmosphere and occasion, from aperitivo moments at *Galileo’s Bar* to Mediterranean-inspired cocktails at *Azure* and refreshing open-air serves at *Solmar Terrace* . Whether guests are gathering with friends before dinner, celebrating a special milestone or simply enjoying a perfectly crafted cocktail at sea, these experiences have been designed to feel immersive, elevated and distinctly Regent.”


**A New Destination for Aperitivo: *Galileo’s Bar***


Inspired by Galileo's spirit of discovery and the Italian tradition of aperitivo, the all-new *Galileo’s Bar* is designed as a destination for conversation and anticipation before dinner. The venue celebrates the transition from day to evening through premium Italian spirits and distinctive cocktail presentations. At the heart of the experience is the *Negroni Observatory* , a collection of imaginative interpretations of Italy's most iconic aperitif, alongside cocktails inspired by the night sky.


Signature creations include:


- **Comet Negroni** featuring Italicus, Beefeater Gin and Noilly Prat Vermouth.
- **Astronomer's Negroni** blending mezcal, Beefeater Gin and Cocchi Storico Vermouth di Torino.
- **Dark Matter Espresso Martini** , a rich pre-dinner cocktail combining Amaro Montenegro, vodka and espresso.
- **Jupiter's Garden** , a bright botanical cocktail featuring gin, Frangelico and fresh basil.
- **Venetian Moon** , an elegant evening cocktail crafted with gin, lychee, lemon and basil.
- **Orbit Zero Espresso Martini** , a zero-proof interpretation featuring Lyre’s Dark Cane, Lyre’s Amaretti and espresso.


**Mediterranean-Inspired Flavors at *Azure***


****


***Azure | Seven Seas Prestige***


At *Azure* , a vibrant collection of herbal cocktails, citrus-led spritzes and regional wines complements the restaurant's Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisine. Inspired by coastal botanicals, aromatic herbs and sun-drenched citrus groves, the beverage program reflects the freshness and relaxed sophistication of the Mediterranean coast. Signature drinks highlight vibrant citrus, floral notes and herbaceous flavors, creating a natural pairing for Azure's mezze-style dining experience.


Signature creations include:


- **Refreshing Flavored Water Selection** , featuring cucumber, lemon, orange or pomegranate-infused water for a refreshing, wellness-inspired option.
- **Monastery Sour:** Combining Bénédictine, brandy, lemon juice, and thyme syrup, finished with a thyme sprig on top of crushed ice. ****
- **Beet and Pear Sour,** blending Pear vodka, Fresh beetroot Juice, Lemon Juice, thyme syrup and egg white ****
- **Provence Bloom,** Featuring Elderflower Liquor, Lavander syrup, Lemon juice, Peach puree, Gin and Tonic Water


**Open-Air Serves at Solmar Terrace**


****


***Solmar Terrace | Seven Seas Prestige***


At *Solmar Terrace at Compass Rose* , guests can enjoy a refreshing collection of wines, cocktails and zero-proof creations designed for open-air enjoyment. Crisp wines, vibrant citrus notes and herbal aromatics pair seamlessly with leisurely daytime dining and sweeping ocean views.


Signature creations include:


- **Pearl of the Riviera** , featuring Grey Goose La Poire, Cocchi Americano, Luxardo Aperitivo and Prosecco.
- **Imperial Yuzu** , combining Junmai daiginjo sake, yuzu sake liqueur, Italicus Bergamot Liqueur and Prosecco.
- **Harissa Bloody Mary** , featuring vodka, Bloody Mary mix, harissa paste and lemon juice.
- **Mediterranean Paloma** , crafted with blanco tequila, pink grapefruit, rosemary honey and soda water.
- **Orchard Fizz** , a refreshing zero-proof option featuring apple juice, lemon and rosemary.
- **Dark ‘n Spicy** , a zero-proof cocktail featuring Lyre’s Spiced Cane Spirit, lime juice, ginger beer and sugar-free vanilla syrup.


Beyond these new concepts, *Seven Seas Prestige* features an array of bars and lounges suited to every occasion, from the elegant *Prestige Lounge* , *Meridian Lounge* and panoramic *Observation Lounge* to the Art Deco-inspired *Connoisseur Lounge* , lively *Casino* , ** al fresco *Pool Bar,* and welcoming *Coffee Connection* . Guests can also enjoy expertly crafted cocktails, fine wines and premium spirits across the ship’s restaurants, each selected to complement the cuisine and dining experience.


The beverage collection is crowned by an exclusive new *Seven Seas Prestige* cocktail, joining Regent’s signature cocktails created for each ship in the fleet. The elegant serve combines Patrón Silver Tequila with Italicus Rosolio di Bergamotto, lime juice, egg white, agave syrup and grapefruit or orange bitters, finished with a dehydrated lime wheel and Himalayan salt.


For more information about *Seven Seas Prestige* or to book a voyage, please visit[RSSC.com/Ships/Seven_Seas_Prestige](http://rssc.com/Ships/Seven_Seas_Prestige) , call 1-844-4REGENT (1-844-473-4368) or contact a professional Travel Advisor.


**ENDS**


***About Seven Seas Prestige™ – A New Legacy Begins* ****


As Regent Seven Seas Cruises’ first new ship-class for a decade, *Seven Seas Prestige* will be 40 percent larger than previous Regent ships, yet accommodates only 10 percent more guests, delivering truly *Unrivaled Space at Sea®* . At 76,550 gross tons with just 411 suites and 630 dedicated crew members, the ship offers one of the highest space-to-guest and crew-to-guest ratios in the cruise industry.


Beautifully appointed all-balcony suites usher in a new era of ultra-luxury accommodation with 12 distinctive categories, featuring four all-new suite types, including the largest all-inclusive, ultra-luxury cruise ship suite in history: the Skyview Regent Suite. Elegant public spaces are thoughtfully designed from the sophisticated, light-filled Starlight Atrium to the art-inspired *Galileo’s Bar* .


Offering Regent guests the chance to indulge in *Epicurean Perfection* ™ like never before, *Seven Seas Prestige* provides a curated culinary journey across 11 dining experiences. These include Azure and Solmar Terrace, signature favorites Compass Rose, Prime 7, Pacific Rim, Chartreuse, Sette Mari at La Veranda and La Veranda, as well as casual venues such as Pool Grill and Coffee Connection, plus 24-hour in-suite dining.


Further elevating the onboard experience, *Seven Seas Prestige* will feature the largest Serene Spa & Wellness® facility in the line’s fleet as well as the all-new Solara Sports Deck and Solara Pool Deck. A crystal light installation will anchor the Starlight Atrium and serves as the centerpiece for Lumière, Regent’s first-ever sound-and-light show that comes to life each evening.


*Seven Seas Prestige's* inaugural season features 12 immersive voyages across the Caribbean and Europe. The ship's maiden sailing departs Miami on December 28, 2026, for an 11-night roundtrip Caribbean voyage visiting destinations in Mexico, Guatemala, Belize, Honduras, Jamaica and the Cayman Islands. The season continues with sailings throughout the Caribbean before crossing the Atlantic to explore the Iberian Peninsula and French coast, including multiple overnight stays. Offering up to 97 included shore excursions per voyage and calls at boutique ports such as St. Lucia, Cartagena and Bordeaux, the season blends immersive exploration with Regent's signature all-inclusive luxury.


***About Regent Seven Seas Cruises®***


Regent Seven Seas Cruises® is the world’s leading ultra-luxury cruise line, inviting guests to Experience the Unrivaled® since 1992. With a maximum of only 411 suites, the line’s perfectly-sized ships - *Seven Seas Explorer®* , *Seven Seas Grandeur* ®, *Seven Seas Mariner* ®, *Seven Seas Navigator* ®, *Seven Seas Splendor* ®, *Seven Seas Voyager* ®, and *Seven Seas Prestige* ™, which is scheduled to be delivered in 2026 - form The World’s Most Luxurious Fleet®. Offering immersive exploration in more than 550 destinations across seven continents, guests travel the world in luxurious space featuring sumptuous all-suite accommodations, nearly all with private balconies, which are among the largest at sea. Regent’s heartfelt personalized service can be found throughout lavish public areas and expansive outdoor spaces, or while savoring incomparable culinary experiences in a range of specialty restaurants and al-fresco dining venues. Guests Cruise In All-Inclusive, Unrivaled Luxury™ as part of Regent’s All-Inclusive Cruise Fares, offering amenities such as unlimited shore excursions, exquisite cuisine, beverages including fine wines and spirits, entertainment, Starlink Wi-Fi, valet laundry, gratuities, a one-night, pre-cruise hotel package for guests staying in Concierge-level suites and higher, and more. For more information, please visit RSSC.com, call 1-844-4REGENT (1-844-473-4368) or contact a professional travel advisor. Regent Seven Seas Cruises has four Prestige Class ships on order scheduled for delivery in 2026, 2030, 2033, and 2036. Regent Seven Seas Cruises® is a wholly owned subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH). To learn more, visit[www.nclhltd.com](http://www.nclhltd.com/) .
